BackstoryDef.title: settlement builder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built settlements for the alliance, turning salvaged metal frames and locally quarried stone into homes. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to strengthen foundations and mend walls, always considering which parts could be taken along when it was time to move again.

BackstoryDef.title: ordnance inspector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] inspected weapons and spare parts bound for the alliance's garrisons, spotting faults in wear patterns and assembly tolerances. [PAWN_pronoun] knew the inspection rules by heart and never excused a rejected batch. Eventually, even ordinary conversation began to sound like fault-finding.

BackstoryDef.title: assembly hall helper
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] helped at the settlement's assembly hall, repainting faded banners and decorating for festivals. The elders taught [PAWN_objective] to recognize old patterns, and [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed explaining to the guests what those designs had meant back home.

BackstoryDef.title: workshop child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up helping [PAWN_possessive] family in a workshop, sorting dismantled parts and repairing doors and windows. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to handle tools early, but often skipped lessons to watch the adults repair machinery and fell behind at school.

BackstoryDef.title: militia trainer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] trained militia members in an alliance settlement, teaching them to defend themselves with knives and clubs and hold narrow passages. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to explain each movement patiently until even the most hesitant recruits could follow along.

BackstoryDef.title: registry clerk
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] copied the alliance's household registers, checking names and dates against damaged records. When the old ledgers became too fragile to turn, [PAWN_pronoun] carefully compared their surviving entries, keeping families from disappearing into the gaps between pages.

BackstoryDef.title: settlement teacher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] taught reading and arithmetic at an alliance settlement school. The children asked about the cities in their old textbooks, so [PAWN_pronoun] searched the surviving records and learned to explain unfamiliar things in words a whole classroom could understand.

BackstoryDef.title: tower watchkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept watch over the approaches to an alliance settlement and practiced with a rifle between shifts. Most nights passed without incident. [PAWN_pronoun] grew used to answering through a radio in a few short words, and seldom said much more off duty.

BackstoryDef.title: refinery technician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serviced equipment at an active matter refinery, calibrating instruments and replacing worn seals. [PAWN_pronoun] studied the processing instructions closely enough to recognize an abnormal reading, and always shut the line down before looking for its cause.

BackstoryDef.title: patrol veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years patrolling the roads between alliance settlements, learning to use a rifle and fight when a patrol was cornered. Bad weather and delayed relief became familiar troubles. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to stay calm until everyone had returned to shelter.

BackstoryDef.title: field cook
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] cooked for an alliance field unit and patched its battered stoves between meals. [PAWN_pronoun] was usually the first awake and the last to finish work, unwilling to rest while the next shift still needed feeding.

BackstoryDef.title: excavation foreman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led an alliance excavation crew, cutting useful metal from old foundations and bracing unsafe tunnels. An early attempt at farming had ended with a ruined harvest. [PAWN_pronoun] decided to leave crops to people who understood them and refused every planting assignment afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: memorial engraver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] engraved memorial plaques for the alliance, correcting every uneven stroke before moving to the next name. An unfinished plate could keep [PAWN_objective] awake with worry. After witnessing a quarry collapse, [PAWN_pronoun] refused to extract stone again and worked only on supplied material.

BackstoryDef.title: night dispatcher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the night shift at an alliance communications station, comparing route reports and arranging relief teams. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to make sense of incomplete messages and settle disagreements over the radio before a missed handover became a larger problem.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant musician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled between settlements, playing old songs, learning new ones and encouraging listeners to sing along. Even after a poor reception or an empty collection bowl, [PAWN_pronoun] could usually find something to look forward to at the next stop.

BackstoryDef.title: greenhouse grower
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the alliance's settlement greenhouses, keeping crops alive through cold spells and unreliable supplies. Between harvests, [PAWN_pronoun] repaired planting beds and patched damaged frames, learning which repairs could wait and which would cost the next crop.

BackstoryDef.title: pack animal keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] cared for the pack animals used to carry supplies between alliance settlements. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to calm frightened animals and treat harness sores before they worsened, often spending the rest stops checking hooves while everyone else unpacked.

BackstoryDef.title: field medic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dressed wounds for an alliance patrol and studied its worn first-aid manuals between journeys. [PAWN_pronoun] could keep a steady hand while treating others, but even a small injury of [PAWN_possessive] own was hard to bear.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan broker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] negotiated purchases for alliance supply caravans, keeping track of prices and the promises made at each stop. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read a stranger's patience as carefully as a ledger, since a useful agreement had to survive the next visit.

BackstoryDef.title: waterworks technician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] repaired pumps and water lines in alliance settlements, tracing old diagrams whenever a buried pipe could not be found. [PAWN_pronoun] became good at fitting mismatched parts together and understanding systems their original builders had never fully documented.

BackstoryDef.title: range instructor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] taught militia recruits to shoot, keeping notes on their practice and the causes of each missed target. [PAWN_pronoun] insisted on checking the sight picture before firing, and had become so used to the routine that even hurried shots took a little longer.

BackstoryDef.title: uniform tailor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made uniforms for an alliance settlement, altering inherited patterns to fit the fabric available. [PAWN_pronoun] took care over the seams around the wings and the placement of insignia, keeping repaired clothing neat enough for another inspection.

BackstoryDef.title: shelter child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a settlement built around an old shelter. The adults taught [PAWN_objective] to check door seals and read the numbered maintenance notices. [PAWN_pronoun] first learned to recognize written words by matching them to the things that needed fixing.

BackstoryDef.title: garrison child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the family quarters of an alliance garrison. Off-duty soldiers sometimes supervised the children at the practice range and taught them how to break a hold. [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed those lessons much more than standing quietly at roll call.

BackstoryDef.title: salvage child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped sort salvage at the edge of an alliance camp, cleaning reusable parts under adult supervision. To find the right bins, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read the markings on old components and asked endless questions about what the broken machines had once done.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood traveling with an alliance caravan, making new acquaintances whenever it stopped. Between visits, [PAWN_pronoun] helped brush the pack animals and learned which ones would stand still while a child checked their harness.

BackstoryDef.title: kitchen helper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped wash vegetables and portion meals in the settlement kitchen. The cooks taught [PAWN_objective] to watch a pot without scorching its contents. At serving time, [PAWN_pronoun] learned how to persuade impatient neighbors to wait their turn.

BackstoryDef.title: mining camp child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside an alliance mining camp, sorting ore and learning to spot useful seams in exposed rock. [PAWN_pronoun] spent much of [PAWN_possessive] free time following the work crews and found it difficult to join the other children's conversations.

BackstoryDef.title: infirmary helper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] often helped at the settlement infirmary, rolling bandages and reading labels aloud for the nurses. [PAWN_pronoun] was allowed to practice simple dressings under supervision, and copied unfamiliar words from the first-aid booklet into [PAWN_possessive] school notebook.

BackstoryDef.title: greenhouse child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] often helped [PAWN_possessive] family in the settlement greenhouse, checking seedlings and keeping a notebook of their growth. When plants wilted, [PAWN_pronoun] would compare the notes with an old growing guide before asking an adult what had gone wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: radio room child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] did schoolwork beside the settlement radio while [PAWN_possessive] family took their shifts. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to copy call signs and pass along short messages, carefully repeating the words until the person at the other end confirmed they were right.

BackstoryDef.title: reservoir keeper's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up near the settlement reservoir, helping patch the fence and cover small leaks. Stray animals often gathered by the water. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to approach them quietly and lead them away before the maintenance crew arrived.

BackstoryDef.title: parcel runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] delivered letters and small parcels around an alliance settlement after school. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which doors required a quiet knock and which residents needed a message explained twice, gradually becoming comfortable speaking to people much older than [PAWN_objective].
